import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { languages } from "../../../backend/schema/languages";

export const languagesCms = customizeTable<typeof languages>("languages", {
    display: {
        title: "englishName"
    },
    fields: {
        englishName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        nativeName: {
            multiline: true
        }
    }
});
